tasks.subject: Helix Mode
tasks.description: Implement a subset of helix's modal editing features (https://docs.helix-editor.com/keymap.html) in the main entry box of the TUI. We mostly need the Normal mode, select_mode (minor mode) and Insert mode. Most of the bindings can be skipped -- the important parts are the multi-selection editing, selection modifications, and the find-replace via the '*' buffer

tasks.subject: Custom Output Style
tasks.description: Create custom output styles for the agent which change the tone and verbiage it choses its responses with. These could be playful (noir, cowboy) or practical (caveman, researcher)
